title: Spring Boot actuator index is exposed
summary: The /actuator index lists every management endpoint the application exposes, which maps the way into env, heap dumps and more.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "json" in header("content-type") and body_contains("_links") and body_contains("self") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Secure the actuator endpoints, or do not expose them in production.
